features: Non-equilibrium production-to-dissipation ratio marks separation shear layers where SST anisotropy is wrong.
SST Bradshaw limiter sensor; drops below 1 where SST clips nut in APG/separation, marking where SST anisotropy needs correction.
Strain-minus-rotation vs turbulence rate distinguishes shear-dominated separation layers (positive) from curvature/recirculation (negative).
Mean acceleration vs turbulence scale marks converging/diverging non-equilibrium upstream of separation and reattachment.

proposal.risk_audit: All three are dimensionless (L/T scaling cancels), denominators use strictly-positive SST quantities (eps, k*omega, omega*d+sqrt(k)) to stay finite at walls and in freestream; Pk/eps and UgradP/(k*omega) are correlated in APG zones but order points differently (magnitude of non-equilibrium vs signed pressure work), wall feature is orthogonal; bounded wall form avoids wall singularity of sqrt(k)/(omega*d).

features.name: f_noneq
features.rationale: Non-equilibrium production-to-dissipation ratio marks separation shear layers where SST anisotropy is wrong.

features.name: f_apg
features.rationale: Signed streamwise pressure work vs turbulence scale marks adverse (positive) vs favorable gradient upstream of separation.

features.name: f_wprox
features.rationale: Turbulent length vs wall distance distinguishes near-wall boundary layer from free shear for SST correction.

proposal.risk_audit: All three are dimensionless (nut*omega/k: (L2/T)(1/T)/(L2/T2); (Snorm-Wnorm)/omega: (1/T)/(1/T); DUDt/(omega*sqrt(k)): (L/T2)/((1/T)(L/T))). Finite: f_curv 100% (omega>0); f_sstlim and f_accel 0/0 only at exact wall (k=0,U=0) like existing f_noneq/f_apg which passed, so >99% finite on cell-centers. Not constant, ordering distinct from I1/I2. Risk: f_sstlim correlates with f_noneq in shear layers but marks SST limiter clipping specifically; f_curv may correlate with I1-I2 but adds signed strain-vs-rotation; f_accel large in freestream acceleration but median-normalized. Dropping f_apg (unused, gain 0) and f_wprox (gain -0.0004, superseded) to free search.

features.name: f_sstlim
features.rationale: SST Bradshaw limiter sensor; drops below 1 where SST clips nut in APG/separation, marking where SST anisotropy needs correction.

features.name: f_curv
features.rationale: Strain-minus-rotation vs turbulence rate distinguishes shear-dominated separation layers (positive) from curvature/recirculation (negative).

features.name: f_accel
features.rationale: Mean acceleration vs turbulence scale marks converging/diverging non-equilibrium upstream of separation and reattachment.

proposal.risk_audit: Dimensionless verified by L-T analysis (UgradP,eps,Pk=L2/T3; gradp*d,k=L2/T2; S,W,omega=1/T). Finite: (S-W)/(S+W+omega) denom>0 everywhere 100% finite; APG and pg-wall singular only at exact wall (k=eps=Pk=U=0) <1% of cell-center points, finite elsewhere. Ordering distinct from I1/I2: signed APG budget, wall-weighted pressure force, bounded shear-vs-rotation. Drop all gain<=0 features (f_noneq hurts heldout despite 1 term, others unused) to free slots and reduce overfit to train separation; new features target bump/CD-channel APG separation, reattachment and curvature.

features.name: f_apg_bal
features.rationale: Signed APG power vs local turbulence energy rate; positive marks APG-driven separation where SST anisotropy fails.

features.name: f_pg_wall
features.rationale: Wall-weighted pressure force vs TKE marks near-wall APG/FPG influence on separation and reattachment.

features.name: f_shear_rot
features.rationale: Bounded shear-vs-rotation with turbulence regularization; zero in attached shear, negative in recirculation/curvature.

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 formulas checked dimensionless under L-T scaling; denominators eps+abs(Pk)>0 and omega*d+Umag>0 for cell-centers so finite, varying, not redundant with I1/I2; drop f_shear_rot with 0 gain/0 terms to free slot; bounded/monotonic forms limit overfit and wall-singularity risk.

features.name: f_acc_pow
features.rationale: Acceleration power vs turbulence energy rate marks curved/rapidly distorted separation where equilibrium SST fails.

features.name: f_wall_free
features.rationale: Turbulent vs wall-plus-mean velocity scale separates near-wall APG/reattachment from free-shear anisotropy error.

features.name: f_noneq
features.rationale: Bounded production-to-dissipation ratio marks non-equilibrium shear layers with production far from dissipation.

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 formulas checked dimensionless under V->2V, L->3L (T->1.5T): ratios of same units only. Denominators strictly positive in cell interiors (omega>0, k>0, Umag>0) so finite on >99%; wall 0/0 risk limited to wall nodes <1%. No duplication of active f_pg_wall/f_noneq/f_wall_free; curvature and TI-separation and stress-magnitude are orthogonal gaps for bump/CDC separation. Dropping only zero-gain zero-terms features.

features.name: f_curv_rot
features.rationale: Bounded rotation-vs-strain with omega regularization marks curved shear and rotation-dominated separation where SST fails.

features.name: f_sep_ti
features.rationale: Turbulence intensity regularized by wall scale peaks in recirculation/wake where mean depleted, marking separation and reattachment.

features.name: f_aniso_mag
features.rationale: Baseline anisotropic stress magnitude vs TKE plus mean/strain energy marks where linear SST constitutive relation is most wrong.
